rationale.text: The field's only mechanism is aria-labelledby pointing to an id that no element has. The test's condition asks for aria-labelledby referencing an identified passage of text, and the glossary describes passages identified by id values, so by the text this field does not meet that condition, nor any other. The custom check does not decide references and answers cannot_tell (step 3); this branch is outside what it supports. The finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.
